slice: RPP-5kh selected 4-to-2 middle-element removal from a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Extends the selected AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE projection to remove the two middle elements from one source-bound four-element style. The exact retained tuples are the first and last source elements. Each consumer's per-vertex parameter pairs are remapped to those ordered survivors and recomputed against the target style and justification. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the MLINESTYLE element count; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per element at each vertex; group 41 carries those parameters; group 75/42 carry area-fill parameter counts and values. The first group-41 value is the distance along the miter vector to the element path intersection.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset; the selected projection is limited to style flag 2.

contract.admission: The original MLINESTYLE body, dictionary/provider graph and each ordinary MLINE consumer must be source-bound. The source has exactly four elements and the target exactly two. Every style-level field must be unchanged, and each target element must equal one full original tuple (offset, color roles, linetype identity and associated indexes/handles). The survivors must form one unique ordered subsequence; this profile retains source indices 0 and 3. The selected route requires AC1027, style flag 2, equal start/end angles, and open/unfilled/uncut consumers whose original MLINE element count is four. All other counts, schemas, flags, angles and carriers remain refused.
contract.geometry: Each selected MLINE has at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, exactly two group-41 parameters for each of the four source elements, zero second parameters and no group-42 fill values. Every source parameter is revalidated. The target first parameters are recomputed for the two retained offsets using target justification shift; the corresponding second parameters follow their source survivor. Group 73 and each vertex's per-element parameter arrays are reduced to two without changing geometry or mutating caller models.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINE retains its redundant group-2 name and group-340 style reference. Output proof checks one MLINESTYLE with group-71 count 2, exact retained group-49 offsets, ACI colors and linetypes; each MLINE has group-73 count 2, six group-74 values of 2, twelve group-41 values, six group-75 values of 0 and no group 42. Fresh import verifies both style tuples, array arity, WCS positions/directions/miters, scale, justification and extrusion for model-space and named-block consumers.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication while preserving destination and caller state; correcting the flag permits same-adapter retry. A 4-to-3 count boundary is deliberately not admitted by this slice and refuses atomically. A late live-consumer parameter mutation after entity staging refuses before publication; restoring the caller snapshot permits a same-adapter retry. Successful output is reopened for semantic field readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. ASCII/binary input and output remain supported. All drawings are authored at runtime from scratch and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output; one four-element style reduced to the exact first-and-last survivor subsequence; flags 2 and equal angles; open, unfilled, uncut ordinary MLINEs; one model-space and one named-block consumer; three vertices; center and bottom justification; and two extrusion planes. It does not qualify other removal positions/counts, one-to-zero, other style edits, other versions/carriers/schemas, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: Runtime-authored style offsets are [1.25, -0.75, -1.25, -2.0], element ACI colors are [1, 3, 4, 5], and linetypes are [ByLayer, Continuous, ByLayer, Continuous]. The selected target is [1.25, -2.0] with colors [1, 5] and linetypes [ByLayer, Continuous]. Model-space and named-block MLINE consumers exercise center and bottom justification, three vertices, and distinct extrusion planes.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four successful source/output combinations and eight successful output readbacks; two invalid-flag refusals preserve destination/caller state and succeed after same-adapter correction; two 4-to-3 boundary refusals preserve destination/caller state; two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve the destination and succeed after caller restoration and same-adapter retry.
